---
title: "Contact"
about:
  template: jolla
format: 
    html:
      css: "style_ct3.scss"
---

```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Contact</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css"> 
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            background-color: #eaf6fb;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        /* Container: form left, image right */
        .contact-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: row; /* Force side-by-side */
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 50px auto;
            padding: 20px;
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .contact-left {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .contact-left-title h2 {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .contact-inputs {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            padding: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #aaa;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .contact-left button {
            padding: 12px 24px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1a73e8, #0044cc);
            color: white;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }

        .contact-left button:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0044cc, #1a73e8);
        }

        .contact-left button img {
            width: 16px;
            margin-left: 5px;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .contact-right {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .contact-right img {
            max-width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }

        /* Responsive: stack on small screens */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .contact-container {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: center;
            }

            .contact-left, 
            .contact-right {
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 500px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="contact-container">
        <form action="https://api.web3forms.com/submit" method="POST" class="contact-left">
            <div class="contact-left-title">
                <h2>Mail me</h2>
                <hr>
            </div>
            <input type="hidden" name="access_key" value="06b8edd5-b593-46dd-a30b-113d5e98d2bc">
            <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Your Name" class="contact-inputs" required>
            <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Your Email" class="contact-inputs" required>
            <textarea name="message" placeholder="Your Message" class="contact-inputs" required></textarea>
            <button type="submit">Send <img src="arrow_icon.png" alt=""></button>
        </form>
        <div class="contact-right">
            <img src="Ed.jpg" alt="Profile Picture">
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>


```
